_doc: The pipeline steps, in order. Source of truth for the preview dashboard and the sk-pipeline table. Built-in steps (check: "builtin") are verified by the preview's own logic. A step you add needs an `evidence` rule the preview can check on disk: {"file": "out/{id}/x.png"}, {"glob": "out/{id}/*-yt.mp4"} or {"json": "src/videos/{id}/x.json", "nonEmpty": "items"}. Remove a step to hide it. Change steps with sk-improve and log it in SOUL.md's change log.

steps.label: Brief
steps.command: cp briefs/_template.md briefs/{id}.md   # then fill it in (sk-brief)

steps.label: Storyboard
steps.command: bun run storyboard {id} --init   # then fill in camera and onScreen, get it approved

steps.label: Scenes
steps.command: bun run dev {id}   # then: bun run check
